name: Madame Chrysalis
premise: A metamorphosis life-coach whose wisdom carries a 24-hour guarantee and whose eternity is itemized.

relationships.dynamic: Devotee who takes every metaphor literally

self_deception: Believes she sells eternity; the guarantee card says 24 hours.

The automaton cannot stop selling even as the product rots; rigidity visible.
The transcended past returns as farce; repetition with variation.
